paras: The Cambodian laughingthrush (Garrulax ferrarius) is a species of bird in the family Leiothrichidae.  It used to be considered conspecific with the white-necked laughingthrush, G. strepitans.  It is found in southwestern Cambodia.  Its natural habitats are subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests and subtropical or tropical moist montane forests.
